title: Coffee scrub cold-process soap
subtitle: An exfoliating bar with spent coffee grounds
excerpt: A cold-process bar made with olive, coconut, and castor oils, with spent coffee grounds and kaolin clay stirred in at trace. The coffee grounds provide a physical exfoliant that rinses away cleanly; the bar lathers normally and smells faintly of coffee in the shower. Makes seven bars; cure four to six weeks.
sourceNotes: Coffee grounds as a soap additive documented in Anne Bramson, Soap: Making It, Enjoying It (1972) and Kathy Miller, The Complete Idiot's Guide to Making Natural Soaps (2010). Kaolin clay in soap: The Soapmaker's Companion by Susan Miller Cavitch (1997). SAP values used: olive oil 0.134, coconut oil 0.190, castor oil 0.128. 5% superfat. Spent grounds preferred over fresh: lower caffeine extraction, finer particle from the brew, and free.

recipe.batchNotes: Run any weight change through a lye calculator. Spent grounds should be fully dry before adding to the batter.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cure four to six weeks. Coffee bars often go through a gel phase that darkens the interior; this is normal and produces a striking two-tone cut if the gel phase is partial.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Two years in a cool dark cupboard once fully cured. Discard if orange rancid patches (DOS) appear or the bar smells sharp and paint-like.

glossaryTerms.definition: The point at which soap batter thickens so that a drizzle on the surface briefly holds its shape before sinking back. Additives like coffee grounds are stirred in at trace to distribute them evenly without deflating the emulsion.
The chemical reaction between fat and sodium hydroxide that produces soap and glycerine. Coffee grounds are inert in this reaction, they stay as physical particles in the finished bar.

projectSchedule.title: Unmould and cut
projectSchedule.body: Turn out the loaf after 48 hours wearing gloves. The bar may show a two-tone pattern from a partial gel phase: a darker, translucent centre surrounded by a paler outside, both zones lather identically. Cut into bars and set on a rack.

projectSchedule.title: Six-week cure complete
projectSchedule.body: The cured bar is firm and dark brown with visible coffee grounds throughout. The faint coffee smell is characteristic.

content.text: Coffee scrub soap is a cold-process bar made with olive, coconut, and castor oils, with spent coffee grounds and a small amount of kaolin clay stirred in at
. The coffee grounds provide a gentle physical exfoliant that rinses away cleanly; the bar lathers normally and smells faintly of coffee in the shower. Makes seven bars; cure four to six weeks
Use spent grounds, fully dry. Fresh grounds are too wet to add cleanly and can introduce mould. Spread the grounds on a baking tray to dry before adding to the batter.

items.prepNote: NaOH at 99% purity; calculated for 5% superfat on this oil blend
spent grounds from a French press or espresso machine, fully dried; stirred in at trace
3% of oil weight; dispersed in a tablespoon of the batch oil before adding

content.text: In a ventilated space, wearing gloves and goggles, pour the distilled water into the HDPE pitcher. Add the sodium hydroxide in a steady stream while stirring. Never add water to lye. Set aside to cool to 38 to 42°C.

Melt the coconut oil. Combine with olive and castor oils in a heatproof bowl. Cool to 38 to 42°C. Disperse the kaolin clay into one tablespoon of the batch oil to remove any lumps; set aside. Weigh the dried coffee grounds into a bowl; set aside.
Blend to trace and add additives

Pour the lye solution into the oils, stirring as you go. Stick-blend to a medium trace. Stir in the dispersed kaolin clay, then stir in the coffee grounds. The batter will thicken further after the grounds are added, pour quickly.

Pour into the silicone loaf mould, smooth the top, and wrap in a towel for 24 hours. Unwrap and leave for another 24 hours. Turn out wearing gloves, cut into bars, and cure on a rack for four to six weeks.
Two years in a cool dark cupboard. The coffee grounds are inert, they do not shorten shelf life. Discard if DOS or sharp paint-like smell develops.
